items.title: Existence of injective hulls by Zorn's lemma
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the existence of an injective hull for an arbitrary module over a ring (author lemma at source lines 697-700, label lemma-injective-hull). The proof (source lines 702-716) embeds the module into an injective module, applies Zorn's lemma to the family of essential extensions of the module inside that injective module - a family shown to be inductive by stability of essentialness under unions of chains - and concludes that a maximal member is injective by the cited criterion, hence is an injective hull (proof lines 713-715). The Zorn argument inside a fixed injective is the substance. H3.
